clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Harken Windtotem guides young hunters across Mulgore’s plains. He teaches the traditions of his people and asks hunters and travelers to prove their tracking and foraging skills.

Near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, Harken Windtotem guides those learning the tauren hunting ways. Life on Mulgore’s plains calls for respect for the natural world and the skills needed to sustain a tribe. Harken tests young hunters by sending them after the swoops that circle the mesas. They gather the birds’ quills, showing patience, aim, and care in taking only what they need.
